-- Final result query
WITH session_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) AS session_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  AND (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END)
       FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) IS NOT NULL
),
session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) AS session_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'source' THEN LOWER(ep.value.string_value) END)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) AS src,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN LOWER(ep.value.string_value) END)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) AS med,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'campaign' THEN LOWER(ep.value.string_value) END)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
session_with_params AS (
  SELECT si.session_id,
         MAX(sp.src) AS src,
         MAX(sp.med) AS med,
         MAX(sp.campaign) AS campaign
  FROM session_ids si
  JOIN session_params sp ON si.session_id = sp.session_id
  GROUP BY si.session_id
),
channel_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN src = '(direct)' AND med IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN src IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'yandex', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia')
           AND (med LIKE '%cp%' OR med LIKE '%ppc%' OR med LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (src LIKE '%facebook%' OR src LIKE '%fb%' OR src LIKE '%instagram%' 
            OR src = 'twitter' OR src = 'linkedin' OR src = 'pinterest' 
            OR src = 'tiktok' OR src = 'badoo' OR src = 'whatsapp')
           AND (med LIKE '%cp%' OR med LIKE '%ppc%' OR med LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (src LIKE '%amazon%' OR src LIKE '%alibaba%' OR src LIKE '%shopify%' 
            OR src LIKE '%etsy%' OR src LIKE '%ebay%' OR src LIKE '%walmart%'
            OR src LIKE '%stripe%' OR src LIKE '%google shopping%')
           AND (med LIKE '%cp%' OR med LIKE '%ppc%' OR med LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (src LIKE '%youtube%' OR src LIKE '%vimeo%' OR src LIKE '%twitch%' 
            OR src LIKE '%dailymotion%' OR src LIKE '%netflix%' OR src LIKE '%disneyplus%')
           AND (med LIKE '%cp%' OR med LIKE '%ppc%' OR med LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN med IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN src IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'yandex', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia')
           OR med = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN (src LIKE '%facebook%' OR src LIKE '%fb%' OR src LIKE '%instagram%' 
            OR src = 'twitter' OR src = 'linkedin' OR src = 'pinterest' 
            OR src = 'tiktok' OR src = 'badoo' OR src = 'whatsapp')
           OR med IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') 
           THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (src LIKE '%youtube%' OR src LIKE '%vimeo%' OR src LIKE '%twitch%' 
            OR src LIKE '%dailymotion%' OR src LIKE '%netflix%' OR src LIKE '%disneyplus%')
           OR med LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (src LIKE '%amazon%' OR src LIKE '%alibaba%' OR src LIKE '%shopify%' 
            OR src LIKE '%etsy%' OR src LIKE '%ebay%' OR src LIKE '%walmart%'
            OR src LIKE '%stripe%' OR src LIKE '%google shopping%')
           THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN med = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN (src IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR med IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')) 
           THEN 'Email'
      WHEN med = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN med = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN (src = 'sms' OR med = 'sms') THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN (med LIKE '%push' OR med LIKE '%mobile%' OR med LIKE '%notification%') 
           THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN campaign LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_with_params
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_sessions
FROM channel_classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC
